blockers.problem: RuntimeMax duration is sampled before package hash/physical unit/resource/intent work and applied only at later systemd dispatch. This can extend external service cap beyond fixed deadline.
blockers.required: Refresh remaining after preflight/intent/output preparation immediately before dispatch; retain actual dispatched remaining and wall/monotonic origin; refuse expired or insufficient window without launch. No original clock reset.

nonblocking_limits: stdout/stderr limits are sampled watchdog thresholds, not hard byte writers; report actual sizes and preserve overshoot/unknown termination honestly. Primary fsynced local event/result custody is independent.
The 26GiB free-memory threshold is a guard, not a shared-host allocation reservation; fresh parent resource admission remains required.
Launching a venv path is safe only if the exact interpreter origin and import inventory match pinned runtime; CLI will refuse mismatch before network work.
scope_no_change: One create-only fsynced launch intent, new unit absence/PID0/empty cgroup, fresh output, no foreign signals.
